prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: cinematic 16:9 conference title background, landscape 1672x941 or similar.
Primary request: an authored DevOps delivery control room, realistic and tactile, with the software delivery chain as the subject. No kitchen metaphor.
Scene: a quiet unattended operations console at night, composed on the RIGHT half only. A low graphite desk carries one open developer laptop angled toward a large smoked-glass monitoring wall. The laptop has a restrained dark source diff/terminal interface, represented as fine ivory and sage lines with no readable code. Behind it, three integrated wide displays form a coherent continuous delivery view: a branching source graph feeds small queued build/test jobs, these converge on a registry-like array of versioned artifact tiles, then fan into a restrained grid of deployed workload instances and one amber operational trace. This should read as real DevOps tooling and a delivery path, not a fantasy hologram, physical factory or network cable diagram. One small coral status in an otherwise healthy sage/ivory pipeline subtly suggests the trusted automation behind the healthy app. No claim or measurement is encoded.
Style: distinctive high-end editorial set photography, precise architectural composition, deep matte graphite, subtle burgundy hardware edge, sage status marks, warm amber task lamp. Rich shadow, cinematic depth, light film grain, reflections controlled. Make the screens and workstation feel inhabited by engineering work without including any person. Low camera at desk level, oblique view with the laptop in the lower right and delivery displays receding toward the upper right; a bold memorable single composition.
Composition: LEFT 54 percent must be near-black empty shadow wall with barely visible material texture for large white title text, no monitors or significant objects on the left. RIGHT 46 percent carries all the engineering detail. Native title and speaker text will be added later, so render NO readable words, labels, numbers, logos or watermarks. No title text. No food, restaurant, infinity symbol, padlocks, shields, hoodies, foreground people, glowing cyber grids, blue neon, random server racks or floating icons. Crisp enough to look intentional projected at conference size, not stock cybersecurity wallpaper.
role: DevOps title alternative next to the selected engineering title. Editorial control-room image; screen marks encode no incident evidence or measured quantities.
status: Rejected as generic AI artwork; retained unused. Native workflow-print experiment also rejected. Current slide 2 uses the visible-app/hidden-toolchain under-floor cutaway documented in artwork-title-devops-underfloor.json.
